rules.title: Notice Required to Determine Estate at Will
rules.requirement: An estate at will may be determined by either party by three months' written notice, or, if rent is payable at periods of less than three months, by written notice equal to the interval between payment days or thirty days, whichever is longer.
rules.key_value: 3 months, or interval between payment days or 30 days, whichever is longer
rules.quoted_span: Estates at will may be determined by either party by three months' notice in writing for that purpose given to the other party; and, if the rent reserved is payable at periods of less than three months, the time of such notice shall be sufficient if it is equal to the interval between the days of payment or thirty days, whichever is longer.

rules.title: Inclusion of Offer for New Tenancy in Termination Notice
rules.requirement: A written notice to determine an estate at will may include an offer to establish a new tenancy for the same premises on different terms, and the inclusion of such an offer does not affect the validity of the notice.
rules.quoted_span: Such written notice may include an offer to establish a new tenancy for the same premises on terms different from that of the tenancy being terminated and the validity of such written notice shall not be affected by the inclusion of such offer.

rules.title: Fourteen Days' Notice to Quit for Nonpayment
rules.requirement: A landlord may determine an estate at will for a tenant's neglect or refusal to pay rent due by giving the tenant fourteen days' written notice to quit.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies in case of neglect or refusal to pay rent due from a tenant at will.
rules.quoted_span: In case of neglect or refusal to pay the rent due from a tenant at will, fourteen days' notice to quit, given in writing by the landlord to the tenant, shall be sufficient to determine the tenancy;

rules.title: Right to Cure Nonpayment Within Ten Days
rules.requirement: A tenancy at will is not determined if a tenant who has not received a similar notice within the preceding twelve months pays or tenders the full amount of rent due within ten days after receiving the notice to quit.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to a tenant who has not received a similar notice from the landlord within the twelve months next preceding receipt of the notice.
rules.quoted_span: provided, that the tenancy of a tenant who has not received a similar notice from the landlord within the twelve months next preceding the receipt of such notice shall not be determined if the tenant, within ten days after the receipt thereof, pays or tenders to the landlord, the landlord's attorney, or the person to whom the tenant customarily pays rent, the full amount of any rent due.

rules.title: Mandatory Notification Language in Nonpayment Notice
rules.requirement: Every notice determining an estate at will for nonpayment of rent must include verbatim statutory notification informing the tenant of the right to cure within ten days if no notice to quit for nonpayment was received within the prior twelve months.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to every notice to determine an estate at will for nonpayment of rent.
rules.quoted_span: Every notice to determine an estate at will for nonpayment of rent shall contain the following notification to the tenant: ''If you have not received a notice to quit for nonpayment of rent within the last twelve months, you have a right to prevent termination of your tenancy by paying or tendering to your landlord, your landlord's attorney or the person to whom you customarily pay your rent the full amount of rent due within ten days after your receipt of this notice.''

rules.title: Extension of Cure Period for Omission of Required Notification
rules.requirement: If a nonpayment notice fails to include the mandatory notification, the tenant's time to pay or tender rent is extended to the day the answer is due in an action to recover possession, though the failure to include the notification does not otherwise affect the validity of the notice.
rules.key_value: extended to the day the answer is due
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies when a notice to determine an estate at will for nonpayment of rent fails to contain the required notification.
rules.quoted_span: If any notice to determine an estate at will for nonpayment of rent shall fail to contain such notification, the time within which the tenant receiving the notice would be entitled to pay or tender rent pursuant to this section shall be extended to the day the answer is due in any action by the landlord to recover possession of the premises. Failure to include such notice shall not otherwise affect the validity of the said notice.

rules.title: Continuance and Reinstatement for Government Subsidy Delay
rules.requirement: If nonpayment was caused by a government delay or failure in delivering a subsistence or rental payment, check, or voucher, the court in a possession action must continue the hearing for at least seven days to notify the agency and must treat the tenancy as not terminated if rent, interest, and court costs are tendered within that time.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies when neglect or refusal to pay rent was caused by government delay or failure in mailing or delivering a subsistence or rental payment, check, or voucher (other than salary) to the tenant or landlord.
rules.quoted_span: If the neglect or refusal to pay the rent due was caused by a failure or delay of the federal government, the commonwealth or any municipality, or any departments, agencies or authorities thereof, in the mailing or delivery of any subsistence or rental payment, check or voucher other than a salary payment to either the tenant or the landlord, the court in any action for possession shall continue the hearing not less than seven days in order to furnish notice of such action to the appropriate agency and shall, if all rent due with interest and costs of suit has been tendered to the landlord within such time, treat the tenancy as not having been terminated.
